name: Camping 101: Skinning

angles.text: As a skinner learning to make a field camp, consult a cook. A campsite needs a basic campfire for warmth and meal preparation.
As an Alliance skinner visiting Elwynn Forest, find Helene Peltskinner in Goldshire to learn this wilderness craft.

faq.answer: In Goldshire, Helene Peltskinner teaches proficient skinners to make a Camp Chair from harvested hides.

aliases: where to turn in camping 101 skinning
faq.answer: Helene Peltskinner teaches proficient skinners to make a Camp Chair in Goldshire.
faq.q: Who teaches skinners how to craft a Camp Chair?

aliases: what does a camp chair do
faq.answer: A Camp Chair gives travelers a seat where they can rest during wilderness journeys.
faq.q: What is the purpose of crafting a Camp Chair?

aliases: where can i place camp chair
faq.answer: Town residents generally dislike camps in the middle of settlements, so set up your camp in the wilderness.
faq.q: Where can adventurers set up camp?

aliases: what do i need for a camp
do i need a fire to camp
faq.answer: A campsite needs a basic campfire. If you do not know how to build one, learn culinary arts from a local cook.
faq.q: What else is required to build a complete campsite?

faq.answer: Skinners proficient at harvesting hides from beasts can learn this craft and put those hides to practical use in the wild.
faq.q: Who is eligible to learn this camping craft?

sections.body: You can shape hides taken from beasts into a Camp Chair for rest in the wild. In Goldshire, Helene Peltskinner teaches proficient skinners to make this seat for travelers on long journeys through dangerous lands.
sections.title: Creature Comforts in the Wild

sections.body: Take your gear into the wilderness before making camp, for townspeople often object to camps in the town square. A field camp also needs a campfire. Many skinners learn basic culinary arts to master fire-building.
sections.title: Rules of the Campsite

summary: In Elwynn Forest, skinners learn Camping 101: Skinning from Helene Peltskinner in Goldshire. She teaches them to shape harvested hides into a Camp Chair for rests beyond settled towns.
